messages.author: abe213dd5b87fbcb
messages.subject: response curve indicate that not all enviromrnt variables be included in the model
parts:
Hi everyone:
    Thanks for this brilliant package for a newbie like me, and I have some basic questions to consult. When I finished the running I noticed that the response curve plot didn't include all environment variables that I upload, so does Wallace only plot the variables which influenced the prediction? and neglect those have no impact on the result? Does their order of variables in the response curve figure indicate the importance order of variables?
     Thanks
Jiang

messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Re: response curve indicate that not all enviromrnt variables be included in the model
parts:
Hi Jiang,

Thanks for your comments! 

About your questions: Wallace is just showing the response curves of the variables that did some contribution to the model, so you are right. The order of the variables are not related with the importance of the variable. Right now, Wallace is not showing any result about variable importance.

Let me know if I answered your questions.

Best,
Gonzalo
